name: Orient Electric Limited
summary: Orient Electric Limited manufactures, purchases, and sells lifestyle electrical products in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Electrical Consumer Durables, and Lighting and Switchgear. The company offers table, stand, wall, lifestyle, exhaust, personal, and silent fans; ceiling fans, including BLDC, high speed, smart, under light, remote controllable, and chandelier fans; mixer and juicer mixer grinders, electric kettles, room heaters, coffee machines, stand mixers, irons, and induction cooktops; desert, tower, personal, window, industrial, and portable coolers; and storage, instant, immersion water heaters.
